# Public empty model fixture

Reviewed snapshot on 2026-10-12 of the knowledge-base model v3, directory v3 and template revision `2026-10-04-model-writing-1`.

Only entity definitions, field semantics, registered lifecycle/directory contracts, inline bodies and empty template files are present. There are no user notes, publishing identities, credentials, personal preferences, tags, sessions or bindings. Template programs are fixture inputs to classify/refuse, never executable test helpers. The synthetic travel facts in the adjacent JSON are explicitly fictional acceptance data.

The current 38 files include 13 command templates, 24 general/periodic/special bodies and one TaskNotes body. Runtime discovery reads the bound library; it does not use this snapshot or hardcode these counts.

The preserved `services/system-engine.cjs` environment fixture contains only business code, reviewed separately (SHA256 `f485a8ea2952d98b0eb1a904a0980b13517d5975a8353ad435df2cfaa463315b`). It is not bundled into the new CLI, copied into installed skill folders or used to execute legacy plans. Native CI loads it inside its isolated vault, as production loads the retained vault service.
